svg.title: kakao-max — Messaging Agent eXtension
svg.desc: 카카오톡의 가능성을, MAX로. MAX means Messaging Agent eXtension. A charcoal and yellow banner featuring MAX, the pixel-art squirrel. Bring KakaoTalk to your AI agents through a headless MCP server. Early public release.

text.font-family: Apple SD Gothic Neo, Noto Sans KR, Malgun Gothic, sans-serif

g.text: A headless MCP bridge for your AI agents.
